skill.name: youtube-comments-api-skill
skill.description: Extract YouTube video metadata and public comment data through the BrowserAct API using keyword, comment limit, and scroll count inputs.
skill.summary: Runs a BrowserAct workflow to collect YouTube search results and public comments for research.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: The skill is an authenticated BrowserAct API wrapper for collecting YouTube video and public comment data. Most static findings are false positives from Markdown backticks or normal API-key naming, but the skill still performs external network calls and one documented Python command. The main security concerns are unsafe API-key disclosure guidance and privacy risk from bulk comment collection.

remediation.issue: API key guidance asks users to provide credentials to the agent.
remediation.suggestion: Require BROWSERACT_API_KEY to be set in the environment or a secure secret store. Remove instructions that ask users to paste the key into chat.

remediation.issue: The skill collects public commenter identifiers and comment text at scale.
remediation.suggestion: Document privacy, consent, retention, and YouTube policy requirements. Collect only fields needed for the stated task and avoid CRM export without a legal basis.

remediation.issue: The documented invocation runs a local Python script with user-provided parameters.
remediation.suggestion: Tell agents to pass arguments without a shell and validate numeric bounds for Comments_limit and Scroll_count before execution.

remediation.issue: Network behavior depends on BrowserAct hosted workflow endpoints.
remediation.suggestion: Document what data is sent to BrowserAct and which endpoints are contacted before users run the skill.

content.value_statement: Teams need reliable YouTube comment data without manual scraping. This skill runs a BrowserAct workflow that returns video metadata, comments, and engagement fields.
actual_capabilities: Starts a BrowserAct workflow from a keyword query.
Sets comment limits and scroll counts for each run.
Polls BrowserAct until the workflow finishes or times out.
Returns video titles, URLs, publish times, and view counts.
Returns commenter names, profile URLs, comment text, likes, and reply counts.
limitations: Requires a valid BrowserAct API key before use.
Sends workflow requests and search parameters to BrowserAct.
Can take several minutes while the hosted task runs.
Does not perform sentiment analysis by itself.

use_cases.title: Audience Research
use_cases.description: Collect comments for a topic so researchers can review common questions, complaints, and engagement signals.

use_cases.title: Competitor Video Review
use_cases.description: Gather video metadata and viewer reactions for competing channels or product topics.

use_cases.title: Content Planning
use_cases.description: Find high-interest videos and comments that reveal viewer needs before planning new content.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Keyword Search

prompt_templates.title: Compare Viewer Feedback
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request across a product topic.
prompt_templates.prompt: Collect YouTube comments for "workflow automation tools" with 20 comments per video and summarize recurring viewer concerns.

prompt_templates.title: Research Competitor Topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Find videos about "no-code browser automation", collect comments, and group feedback by objections, desired features, and purchase intent.

prompt_templates.title: Build Analysis Dataset
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for structured follow-up analysis.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the skill for "AI browser agents" with a higher scroll count, then prepare a clean research brief with source video links and comment themes.

output: A list of matching YouTube videos with title, URL, publish time, and view count.
Associated comments with commenter names, profile links, text, likes, publish dates, and reply counts.

output_examples.input: Collect comments for competitor videos about browser automation.
output_examples.output: A research-ready set of video links and viewer reactions that can be reviewed for product positioning and audience concerns.

output_examples.input: Track viewer response to a trending keyword.
output_examples.output: A combined view of recent video metadata and public comment discussions for the selected YouTube search term.

best_practices: Set BROWSERACT_API_KEY securely before starting the skill.
Use the smallest comment limit that answers the research question.
Review privacy and platform rules before exporting commenter data.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into chat or shared transcripts.
Do not collect more commenter data than the task requires.
Do not treat raw comments as sentiment analysis without separate review.

faq.question: What does this skill collect?
faq.answer: It collects YouTube video metadata and public comment fields returned by the BrowserAct workflow.

faq.question: Do I need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. The script requires BROWSERACT_API_KEY to authenticate with BrowserAct.

faq.question: Does it scrape YouTube directly from my machine?
faq.answer: No. It starts and polls a hosted BrowserAct workflow through the BrowserAct API.

faq.question: Can it analyze sentiment automatically?
faq.answer: No. It gathers comment data that another tool or prompt can analyze afterward.

faq.question: How long does a run take?
faq.answer: A run can take several minutes while BrowserAct loads videos and comments.

faq.question: What should I check before using the output?
faq.answer: Check privacy obligations, YouTube policy, and whether you need to remove or minimize personal data.
